thread:
sam-ops: FYI scheduling a short KV-router health check next Tue 02:00-02:30 UTC. This will run rolling checks on routing tables, non-disruptive in normal, but we want oncall coverage and a statuspage blurb. draft below.

priya-oncall: thanks. expected impact? any risk of 5xx spikes or reconnects for long-lived streams?

emily-sre: low risk. checks are read-only + control-plane probes. We will drain one router at a time, wait for prefix convergence (TTL ~15s). Potential transient 504s if a downstream link flaps. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/ops/runbooks/kv-router-healthcheck (see section 2 for fallback).

sam-ops: perfect. policy is: if >1% 5xx across region for 3m we abort and rollback. If latency P95 rises >200ms for 5m -> abort. Priya you'll be primary, Emily secondary. Carlos, can you draft customer copy?

carlos-support: sure. starting draft: "We will be performing routine health checks on our routing layer on Tue 02:00-02:30 UTC. Expected impact: none for most customers. We may see very short request retries (<30s) for a small percentage of requests. No action required. Support will monitor and provide updates at status.redwood.com." Want tone to be low-friction.

priya-oncall: got it. can we include recommended contact for customers on Dedicated? e.g., "Dedicated customers with pinned capacity: contact your AM or support@redwood if you see issues"

carlos-support: added that line. full draft below (for statuspage and email):

"Planned maintenance: KV router rolling health checks
When: Tue 02:00-02:30 UTC
Impact: Expected to be non-disruptive. A small number of requests may be retried briefly.
If you see problems: open a ticket or contact support@redwood.com. Dedicated customers: please reach out to your AM.
"

emily-sre: ops checklist for oncall:
- pre-check: confirm router replicas healthy and routing table delta <0.5%
- run one router drain, monitor for rebalances (watch prefix convergence)
- observe 5xx/latency, abort if thresholds hit
- post-check: run `curl` smoke tests and kv-consistency check

incident-bot: [AUTO] Pager rule created: #kv-router-healthcheck → eng-oncall. Pager test scheduled at 01:50 UTC.

sam-ops: quick note on metrics dashboards: watch `kv.router.5xx_rate`, `kv.router.p95_latency`, and `kv.router.prefix_convergence`. I added a temporary dashboard panel with 1m granularity. Link: https://metrics.redwood/d/kv/health-checks

priya-oncall: putting a brief statuspage message in staging for review. Posting proposed statuspage entry below — please thumbs up if OK.

carlos-support: looks good to me. :thumbsup:

priya-oncall: STAGING statuspage message (please don't publish yet):
"We will perform rolling health checks on the KV routing layer on Tue 02:00-02:30 UTC. No downtime expected. We may see short-lived retries for a small subset of requests. We'll post updates here if anything changes."

emily-sre: LGTM. Also adding a short customer-facing optional line for Dedicated: "Customers with reserved/dedicated capacity may see brief retry behavior; contact your AM for assistance."

sam-ops: plan agreed. oncall rota: Priya primary 01:45-03:00 UTC, Emily fallback. I'll monitor the pager.

-- later, during the window --

incident-bot: [AUTO] Pager test fired at 01:50 UTC — no action required.

priya-oncall: starting drain on router-7 in us-west1. watching metrics.

emily-sre: observing slight bump in p95 (~30ms) and one transient 502 spike for ~12s. still under thresholds.

priya-oncall: starting router-3 now.

sam-ops: monitoring. so far behavior matches runbook. statuspage: publishing: "In progress — performing rolling KV router checks. No customer action required."

carlos-support: publishing customer email: sent to mailing list. copy: "We're running routine routing checks now; no action required. We'll update when complete."

-- after completion --

priya-oncall: completed drains, ran smoke tests, all green. post-check KV consistency OK.

emily-sre: post metrics look normal, no sustained 5xx or latency issues. good to mark done.

sam-ops: marking maintenance as complete. statuspage updated: "Completed — KV router health checks finished with no impact observed." Closing pager.

carlos-support: sending completion email to customers: "Maintenance complete. If you experienced issues, please reply to support@redwood.com and we'll investigate"

incident-bot: [AUTO] Maintenance event closed. Duration: 18m.

sam-ops: quick retrospective note: add a short blurb to runbook about increasing control-plane probe interval if we see repeated 502s during drains. Also add a template for Dedicated customer AM outreach.

priya-oncall: noted, I'll update the runbook and the ops checklist tomorrow morning.

emily-sre: thanks team. nice and smooth. :tada:
